run3_result.defectStep: Partner-discount base seed for non-USD lines in Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (ESDV 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). On non-USD partner lines, Pre_Partner_Price__c / the partner-discount base is computed as USD_list x org-corporate-rate (EUR 0.92) BEFORE the partner discount, while the proc ALSO applies its own hardcoded EUR FX step (CurrencyConversionNetUnitPrice, sequenceNumber 35, multiplier 0.9346 at proc line 106524) at the END. This double-converts non-USD partner lines: Net = USD_list x 0.92(corporate) x (1-type%) x 0.9346(hardcoded), i.e. the intended USD_list x (1-type%) x 0.9346 is multiplied by an extra 0.92. USD lines are unaffected (USD->USD corporate conversion = 1.0). NOTE: this corrects the prior executor mis-attribution - the 0.92 is the org corporate currency rate (a spurious second FX conversion), NOT Services_Percent__c (8%). The two values coincide numerically (1-0.08 = 0.92) but Perpetual(15%) and Services(8%) lines are ALSO understated by exactly 0.92, proving it is currency not a type-specific percent.
